comments.story: FizzBuzz Mario World: Learning Assembly Language and Having Some Fun
comments.why: TAS-only arbitrary code execution exploit in Super Mario World.
comments.text: Somewhat disappointed. I was expecting them to use the well-known arbitrary code execution exploit in this game to load their own implementation of FizzBuzz, cf. [VIDEO] The method used by Masterjun3 is TAS-only (it involves executing the contents of the controller registers as code, which requires frame-precise inputs), but there are some other methods which are more viable for a real-time attack.
